question: If an opponent loses the game after I announce a spell with undaunted and determine its total cost, do I have to pay more mana?

expected.shortAnswer: No: causing an opponent to lose after the cost is determined does not make you pay more.
expected.answer: Causing an opponent to lose the game after you’ve announced that you’re casting a spell with undaunted and determined its total cost won’t cause you to have to pay more mana.
